comments.author: Tarmanydyn
comments.body_html:
Found an issue that I was able to narrow down, but not necessarily fix. Not sure which mod is actually responsible, but I figure I post here.

Found an issue with Mechanic’s shop not loading, saw that this is a potential issue with Massivesoft Guns (MS-G). This workaround fixed it for a bit (https://forge.sp-tarkov.com/mod/2309/zzzmassivesoft-mechanic-fix), but afterwards, all the trading windows eventually became problematic, switching between traders was slow, until the tabs/UI became unresponsive.

After completely removing MS-G, I’ve had none of the above issues. Again, not sure if it’s a broader MS-G issue, or an interaction between MS-G and Realism that this patch pack didn’t address, or perhaps a mysterious third option..

I’m running pretty much all the other mods listed + realism with no other issues so far, so thanks for this!
